column3: \tまずは健太郎君に関する美樹を記憶を見るわね・・
column4: First, I will view Miki's memories about Kentarou-kun...

column3: \t\t時間にして３０分ほど・・ランスとワーグは二人の出会いから
column4: About 30 minutes in time... Rance and Warg watch from the two's meeting

column3: \t\t今にいたるまでの出来事を美樹の記憶視点から覗いた
column4: up to the present events from Miki's memory perspective.

column3: \t\t・・・健太郎君、とってもいい子じゃない。悪人じゃないわ、一途で素敵
column4: ...Kentarou-kun is a really good guy. Not a bad person, earnest and wonderful.

column3: \t\t異世界（ランスからは）での生活、健太郎とは幼なじみ・・仲良し
column4: Life in another world (from Rance's view), Kentarou is his childhood friend... close friends.

column3: \t\tだが、ある日、異世界（私達の世界に）に掠われた。
column4: But one day, she was taken to another world (our world).

column3: \t\t魔王になれて脅迫された怖かった美樹・・そして噛まれて魔王の血を入れられた
column4: Miki was scared, forced to become Demon King and threatened... then bitten and infused with Demon King's blood.

column3: \t\t自分が徐々に変わっていく恐怖・・
column4: The fear of gradually changing herself...

column3: \t\tそこに健太郎が助けに来てくれた、うれしかった
column4: Then Kentarou came to help, which made her happy.

column3: \t\t美樹の記憶なので健太郎の活躍は描かれていない
column4: Because these are Miki's memories, Kentarou's efforts aren't detailed.

column3: \t\t魔王ガイを倒し、美樹を助けにきた所だけ
column4: Only the part where he defeated Demon King Gai and came to rescue Miki.

column3: \t\tこの事については、ワードとランスの会話で表現
column4: This is expressed through the conversation between Warg and Rance.

column3: \t\t健太郎は楽した訳では無いんじゃない、知らないけど・・
column4: Kentarou probably didn't have it easy, I don't know for sure though...

column3: \t\t異世界から来て、苦労して、日光さんと出会って、いくつの試練を越えて
column4: He came from another world, endured hardships, met Nikkou-san, and overcame many trials.

column3: \t\tこうして魔王ガイを倒したの、ランスよりすごいんじゃないとか
column4: And thus defeated Demon King Gai-maybe even more impressive than Rance.

column3: \t\tこの後も二人の物語は続いた
column4: After this, their story continued.

column3: \t\t魔王になりかけ、再び囚われる美樹を取り戻す健太郎
column4: Kentarou retrieving Miki just as she was about to become the Demon King and was captured again.

column3: \t\tうーん、アホな奴と思っていたが、なかなかやるじゃないか
column4: Hmm, I thought he was an idiot, but he's actually quite capable.

column3: \t\tしかし、これだけ一緒にいて美樹ちゃんに手を出してないなんて、そこはアホだな
column4: However, the fact that he hasn't made a move on Miki-chan despite being this close-that part is dumb.

column3: \tよし、では、記憶書換だ。今の健太郎のシーン、全部俺様にしろ
column4: Alright, then rewrite the memories. Change all the scenes with Kentarou to me.

column3: \t\t今の感動的な記憶見て、よくそんな事言えるわね・・とワーグ
column4: Warg says, 'After seeing those touching memories, you can say that...'

column3: \t\tでも、やってくれる・・
column4: But he'll do it...

column3: \t\tビジュアルの、健太郎がランスに書き換わる
column4: In the visuals, Kentarou is rewritten as Rance.

column3: \t\t過去シーンの一部、４．５台詞だけ再生。健太郎でなくランスが語り
column4: Playback of a part of a past scene with about 4-5 lines. Rance speaks instead of Kentarou.

column3: \t\t美樹がランス君と返事している感じの所を
column4: At the part where Miki responds to Rance-kun.

column3: \tで・・フェードアウト
column4: Then... fade out.
